author: _Bunnies
body:
So, I'm relatively inactive here, and haven't kept up with news on this server, but I'm from OCN, and wouldn't mind getting into the community.

I won't be wonderfully active here, since I'm parts of other communites, OCN and UHC in particular.


Past Experience on OCN:

Tourney three, RotLW - Team Nope, top 16

Tourney four, GoG - Oblivion, top 16

Tourney five, RotH - Bolt, Didn't make invitationals

Tourney six, BC - Space Monkey Mafia, Top 8

Mini Event one, KotW - Bolt, Fifth place

Mini Event three, BiaB - Bolt, Top 16

Tournament seven, GotW - Sat out, unofficial LunGGLove Cheerleader

Tournament eight, Conquest - Tribe7x (Bolt), Top 16


As you can see I've been playing for a while, so I wouldn't mind getting a foot in other communities too.
